title: Tiangco, Erice plan to question House version of budget bil before SC
summary: Two members of the House of Representatives on Wednesday bared plans to question before the Supreme Court its version of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill if the chamber failed to cure the alleged…

blocks.text: Two members of the House of Representatives on Wednesday bared plans to question before the Supreme Court its version of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill if the chamber failed to cure the alleged defects in the approval of its own budget.
Navotas City Rep. Toby Tiangco said the House budget was neither discussed in the House Committee on Appropriations nor in the plenary.
Tiangco has filed House Resolution 1590 to have the committee and the plenary discuss the House budget.
The House approved on third and final reading the proposed P7.2 trillion 2027 national budget in October.
The Senate is currently deliberating the budget bill.

"Ang hindi nila puwedeng ayusin is yung prosesong hindi namin ginawa para sa sarili naming budget ng House of Representatives. Yon, hindi kayang ayusin ng Senado yon. Kami dapat mag-ayos noon kasi yon ay prosesong nakapaloob doon sa amin. Yong prosesong hindi namin sinunod, kahit anong gawin ng Senate, hindi nila maaayos yon. Kaya nga ang request ko sa House, ayusin na namin kaysa umabot pa doon sa kukuwestiyunin sa Supreme Court," Tiangco said during today's Kapihan sa Manila Bay.
"Pag hindi pa rin nila inayos despite the fact na sinabi namin na kukuwestiyunin namin sa Supreme Court 'yan, isa lang ibig sabihin, may tinatago talaga," he added.
Tiangco and Caloocan City 2nd district Rep. Edgar Erice are among 13 members of the House of Representatives who voted no to the House General Appropriations Bill.
Erice recommended that all congressional insertions in the HGAB be flagged.

"I don't think the Senate will have the material time to scrutinize all the insertions... Ang dapat mangyari riyan, lahat ng insertions, except for institutional insertions, red flag na. Red flag na dapat," Erice said during the Kapihan sa Manila Bay.

"Kung talagang importante yung mga projects, alisin muna nila tapos mag-submit sila ng supplemental budget. Ilagay nila doon yung mga importante matapos na ma-scrutinize noong mga agencies at ng House at ng Senate," he added.
Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian earlier said the Senate will remove P8.8 billion worth of infrastructure projects that lack documentation.

"'Yong sinasabi ni Sen. Sherwin Gatchalian na P8 billion lang ang tatanggalin, aba! Ano lang yan, consuelo de bobo lang. Ibig sabihin, baka sa Senado, meron din kayong mga insertions doon sa BARSC (Budget Amendments Review Sub-Committee), kaya ayaw ninyong tapyasin yung lahat ng mga insertion," Erice stated.

"Palagay ko, kung may nag-insert diyan, pinakiusap sa BARSC para 'di na ma-scrutinize ni Senator Lacson. Kasi may nakita akong mga distrito, localities ng mga senador na biglang lumobo yung mga insertions," he added.
Erice also called on the House leadership to include in the House contingent to the bicameral conference committee for the proposed 2027 budget members of the House who voted no to the HGAB.

"Nananawagan tayo sa leadership ng House. Alam mo, merong 13 bumoto ng no sa House out of the 300-plus. Dapat siguro, hinihiling natin na magkaroon ng representation sa bicameral conference committee. Bakit? Kasi yung lahat ng bumoto ng yes, walang nakitang mali. Eh, yung lahat ng bumoto ng no, may nakita. At mahalaga sa bicameral conference committee na ma-discuss yung mga mali," Erice explained.
GMA News sought House Speaker Faustino Dy III's comment, but he has not yet issued a statement.
Earlier, the speaker said he will create a transparency portal where the public can check government-funded projects.

"Kung gusto talaga nila ng transparency, bakit nila ni-reject yung dalawang proposals ko? 'Yon ang hindi ko maintindihan... Nakasulat 'yon sa rules namin, yung pangalawa, na talagang idi-disclose ng BARSC yong budget per district," Tiangco said.
"Ang una nating itanong kay Speaker, kasama ba riyan sa portal yung House budget?" Erice said.
"Simpleng-simple lang, ang tagal-tagal na, priority legislation ng pangulo, CADENA Act. Bakit ayaw ipasa ng House?" Erice asked.

The CADENA Act or the Citizen's Access and Disclosure of Expenditures for National Accountability Act mandates the disclosure of government transactions on a digital platform using modern technology like blockchain. –NB, GMA News
